text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Educational Institutions Cittion and
(Discipline) (Third Schedule) (Amendment) Order 1997.       —

(2) This Order shall come into force on 1 January 1998.

2. The Third Schedule to the Educational Institutions (Discipline) Amendment
Act 1976 is amended—                                      aa

(a) in subparagraph (1)—

(i) in the national language text by substituting for the
word "lapangan" wherever appearing the word
"bidang"; and

P.U. (A) 538-539.                             3662

(ii) in subsubparagraph (b) by substituting for the words
"secret ballot, conducted by the Students' Affairs
Officer" the words "secret ballot or in any other
manner determined by the Students' Affairs Officer";
(b) in paragraph 6—
(i) by renumbering subparagraph (1) as paragraph 6;
and
(ii) by deleting subparagraph (2); and
(c) in paragraph 7—
(i) by deleting the word "and" appearing at the end of
subsubparagraph (b);
(ii) in subsubparagraph (c) by substituting for the full
stop a semi-colon; and
(iii) by inserting after subsubparagraph (c) the following
subsubparagraph;

"(d) to foster a spirit of corporate life among the
students of the Institution; and

(c) to assist the Institution authorities to maintain
discipline among students.".

Made 30 December 1997,
[KP (PUU) S 10075/07/10; PN. (PU?) 365.]

Dato' Sri Morb Nasib BIN Tun Hast ABpUL Razak,
Minister of Education

P.U. (A) 539.
AKTA INSTITUSI PENDIDIKAN TINGGI SWASTA 1996

PERATURAN-PERATURAN INSTITUSI PENDIDIKAN
Tinggi SWASTA (PENUBUHAN) 1997

Akm 555.           Pada menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 88 Akta Institusi
Pendidikan Tinggi Swasta 1996, Menteri membuat peraturan-peraturan
yang berikut:

Nama dan mula. 1, Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
berkust kunsa. Tn stitusi Pendidikan Tinggi Swasta (Penubuhan) 1997 dan hendaklah
mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 1998.

Tafsiran.     2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya
menghendaki makna yang lain—

"cawangan" ertinya cawangan suatu institusi pendidikan tinggi
swasta yang ditubuhkan di bawah Akta;
